schema.notes: Draft content for factions/sects/schools. Techniques use sutra_* (esoteric/scripture) and mutra_* (form/mantra) IDs following repo conventions. Access levels: outer_disciple, inner_disciple, famous_disciple, holy_disciple, elder, vice_leader, leader.
